Project overview

Architectural Blueprint & Key Facts.

Designed as an exclusive low-density residential community where contemporary styling meets coastal micro-climatic intelligence.

Urban Address

Bendoorwell, Mangaluru

Direct access from existing 9.00M and proposed 6.00M wide municipal roads, situated within minutes of PVS Junction and central city conveniences.

Exclusive Density

22 Residential Apartments

An intimate enclave with only 4 residences per typical floor, eliminating shared common living walls and providing unparalleled residential privacy.

Building Structure

Ground + 4 Upper Floors

Low-rise contemporary architecture engineered with robust RCC framework, cantilevered balconies, and a finished rooftop terrace with pergola canopy.

Dedicated Parking

Subterranean Basement

Dedicated basement parking garage with numbered bays, gentle vehicular entry/exit ramps, wide driveways, and direct lift core access.

Vertical Mobility

8-Passenger Automated Lift

1 automated high-speed elevator with automatic rescue device (ARD), connecting basement parking through all residential upper floors.

Power & Utilities

Dual Water & Standby Generator

Dual water supply via Borewell + Corporation connection, rainwater harvesting, reticulated gas line, and soundproof generator backup.

Exterior architecture

The Architectural Gallery.

Examine the exterior craftsmanship of Lotus Signature, from its striking multi-tiered balconies and wood-accented soffits to its welcoming ground-level arrival.

Interior proportions

Crafted Living Spaces.

Step inside residences conceptualised to maximise cross-ventilation, abundant coastal daylight, and durable high-specification materials throughout.

Expansive Living Salon

Generous ceiling heights with putty-finished smooth surfaces, large format vitrified tiles, and expansive sliding aluminium fenestration opening directly onto breezy balconies.

SpecificationMelamine polished main door entrance & vitrified flooring

Master Bedroom Suite

A private peaceful sanctuary with dedicated ensuite bathroom featuring digital tiles up to ceiling height, Jaguar CP fittings, and tranquil natural lighting.

SpecificationPainted flush doors & anti-skid ceramic bathroom floors

Contemporary Kitchen & Dining

Polished natural granite countertop paired with a stainless steel sink, reticulated piped gas supply, dedicated utility balcony, and dual water supply.

SpecificationGranite counter, stainless sink & reticulated gas line

Technical excellence

Detailed Project Specifications.

Every component and building system is selected for enduring performance in Mangaluru's coastal environment, supported by trusted brand partners.

Doors & Windows

Crafted entryways and precision fenestration

Main Entrance Door
Decorative melamine polished main entrance veneer door with solid structural frame.
Internal Room Doors
Wooden door frames with good-quality painted flush door shutters for all internal rooms.
Toilet Door Shutters
Durable fibro-tech shutters engineered for moisture resistance and lasting integrity.
Windows & Ventilators
Aluminium windows with smooth sliding shutters for inside apartment spaces.

Flooring & Surfaces

Premium vitrified tiles and natural stone selections

Apartment Interiors
High-grade vitrified tile flooring inside the apartments for an elegant seamless look.
Common Corridors & Lobbies
Combination of premium granite and vitrified tile flooring across all common areas.
Toilet Flooring
Coloured ceramic anti-skid tiles for safe, slip-resistant toilet floor surfaces.

Kitchen & Utility

Functional elegance and durable craftsmanship

Kitchen Countertop
Polished natural granite counter paired with heavy-duty stainless steel sink.
Plumbing & C.P Fittings
High-grade C.P fittings provided for kitchen sink, utility taps and dining areas.
Gas Provision
Reticulated piped gas connection point routed directly to each residence.

Bathrooms & Sanitary

Digital tiles and precision Jaguar fittings

Wall Cladding
Designer digital wall tiles laid seamlessly up to the ceiling height.
CP & Sanitary Ware
Fittings in all toilets are of Jaguar or equivalent reputable make.
Water Management
C.P fittings provided across all toilet points, kitchen and dining hand-wash.

Paint & Wall Finishing

Smooth putty preparation and refined palette

Interior Ceilings & Walls
Putty-finished painting for interior walls and ceilings delivering clean, flawless surfaces.
Exterior Elevation
Weather-resistant exterior acrylic paint system designed to endure coastal Mangaluru weather.

Water Supply & Sustainability

Dual-source supply and conscious conservation

Water Sources
Continuous dual water supply with on-site deep Borewell in addition to Corporation water connection.
Storage Infrastructure
Overhead water storage tank and underground sump tank equipped with automatic pumping systems.
Rainwater Harvesting
Integrated rainwater harvesting system designed for groundwater recharge and sustainability.

Electrical, Backup & Common Facilities

Uninterrupted power, surveillance and mobility

Generator Power Backup
Dedicated standby generator with soundproof acoustic enclosure powering common areas and apartment lighting.
Automated Passenger Elevator
1 automated 8-passenger elevator serving basement parking through all residential upper floors.
CCTV Surveillance
Comprehensive CCTV coverage monitoring entrance gates, lobbies, and parking areas.
Parking Facilities
Covered car parking in the dedicated basement and ground-level driveways.
